name: opencode-slides
description: Slide review side panel for the OpenCode desktop app: see each slide, comment on elements, send to the model.

scripts.build: bun build src/gui.js --format=cjs --target=node --outfile=gui-experimental.cjs --external effect --external solid-js --external solid-js/web --external solid-js/store --external @opencode/plugin/gui --external @opencode/plugin/rpc --external @opencode/schema/rpc --external @opencode/client --external electron --external node:child_process --external node:fs --external node:fs/promises --external node:path --external node:os --external node:crypto
scripts.build:viewer: bun build viewer/app.jsx --format=iife --target=browser --minify --outfile=dist/viewer.js --external three --external @ai-sdk/react --external ai --external y-websocket --external y-webrtc --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
